title: Signals beyond the usual range
description: A measured process line with caller-supplied statistical limits, exact breach markers and optional event references.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, x, value } observations. IDs are unique and nonempty; numeric X coordinates are finite and strictly increasing. Signed finite values render; missing or invalid readings break the line and remain inspectable. Equality to either limit is not a breach.

props.name: limits
props.description: Caller-supplied finite ordered { lower, center, upper } statistical control limits, or null. Invalid limits are unavailable while measured observations remain visible. These are not business targets. No process model or run rules are inferred.

props.name: events
props.description: Optional { id, x, label } events, with unique nonempty IDs and finite numeric X inside the observation window. Numbered native reference lines correspond to the event key.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading identifying the measured quantity or analytical question.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional reporting period, units or statistical context supplied by the application.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats absolute readings and tooltip values; axis ticks use compact numbers. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
